CALIBRATION
BLACK POINT CAL

Calibration — place the device on a plain white sheet, press Start, and keep gliding until the confirmation appears. This measures each pixel's dark offset and gain plus the sensor response curve, and stores them on the device.

Black point cal — place the device on the matte black paper you want rendered as pure black, press Start, and keep gliding until the confirmation appears. The device measures the residual brightness of every pixel on that paper and sets the black point just above it, so the paper reads as uniform black without crushing more shadow detail than necessary. The value is applied immediately, saved, and shown in the BLACK POINT selector — which you can still use to override it manually.
